In arbitrary $\triangle ABC$,

[[File:Triangle-with-notations.svg|300px|center]]

$$
\begin{align}
c^2 &= a^2 + b^2 - 2ab\cos\gamma, \\[3mu]
a^2 &= b^2+c^2-2bc\cos\alpha, \\[3mu]
b^2 &= a^2+c^2-2ac\cos\beta.
\end{align}
$$

== Proof ==

=== Via the Pythagorean theorem ===
